The University of Tennessee, Knoxville, is hiring a Post-doctoral Research Associate to study AI integration in higher education research methods courses.

Focus: AI-assisted learning, pedagogical frameworks, and mixed-methods research.

Qualifications: PhD in Education, CS, Learning Sciences, or related field; strong quantitative skills.

Salary: $60,000 - $70,000 (Onsite).

Review Date: Begins March 30th.
